node.statement: In the unital Banach algebra CB(B(H)), ||4Delta||_cb <= 4eta <= 1/2 < 1. Therefore the holomorphic inverse-square-root branch at I agrees with the absolutely norm-convergent binomial series (I-4Delta)^(-1/2)=sum_(n>=0) c_n(4Delta)^n, where c_n=binom(2n,n)/4^n >= 0 and sum_(n>=0)c_n x^n=(1-x)^(-1/2) for |x|<1. Subtracting I and using the triangle inequality and submultiplicativity gives ||(I-4Delta)^(-1/2)-I||_cb <= sum_(n>=1)c_n(4||Delta||_cb)^n <= sum_(n>=1)c_n(4eta)^n=(1-4eta)^(-1/2)-1.
